description: (0.5.0) Feed entries commit atomically with their change (RFC-ACDP-0018 §5.3). Behavioral, registry-side; partly a self-test obligation.

input.setup: Concurrent retract/republish of X interleaved with supersessions of Y.

expected.behavior: Every element of every context's registry_state.event_receipts has exactly one lifecycle entry with that event_id; every superseding body has one superseded entry.
Every feed entry's evidence resolves to a stored event, receipt or body.
For one context, lifecycle entries appear in ascending event_receipt.index order.
